LESSON: CHRISTIAN MORAL VALUES: PURITY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible Selected Teachings
Topic 2.1: Christian Moral Values: Purity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Christian Moral Values: Purity. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how one can avoid being lured to same-sex relationships, 1. How can you live a morally upright life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify moral values that a young person should uphold
2. describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Christian Moral Values: Purity helps you communicate well at school and at home.

• Listen with your eyes and ears. Face the speaker and wait for your turn.

• When you speak, use a clear voice and polite words.

• Practise short dialogues with a partner using Kenyan school situations.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short instruction, then repeat it to a friend in your own words.

Example 3: Role-play buying an item at the market using polite requests: “Please…”, “Thank you.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Practise a 30-second greeting dialogue with a partner.
2. Listen to three instructions and carry them out in order.
3. Tell a short news item from your day using complete sentences.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Teach a younger learner one polite greeting from this lesson.
2. Write five sentences you can say when welcoming a visitor at school.
3. Ask a parent to give you three oral instructions; write them down after listening.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Team up to discuss moral values that youths should uphold to overcome sexual sins,
2. Brainstorm on 1 Corinthians 15:33, 1 Thessalonians 4:3, 1Corinthians 6:13, 1 Corinthians 6:18-20, Leviticus 11:44, and discuss the moral values outlined,
3. Research or read about sexual perversions today and how youths are lured,
4. Work with peers to read Galatians 5:19 and Leviticus 18:5-18, 20-23, and use PowerPoint slides or charts to list forbidden sexual practises,
5. Discuss how to avoid getting lured into forbidden sexual practises,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how one can avoid being lured to same-sex relationships, 1. How can you live a morally upright life?
2. Why should you maintain sexual purity as a Christian youth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Good listeners look, wait, and respond.
2. Clear speech helps others understand you.
3. Polite language shows respect.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
